name: ai-tool-consolidation-audit
display_name: AI Tool Consolidation & Data-Hygiene Audit Skill
description: One skill: /ai-tool-audit. Run a short guided interview on which AI tools your firm uses, for what, and with what data; the skill builds a tool inventory, rates each tool's data-handling status, flags redundant tools by workflow, and recommends genuine consolidation candidates onto a governed Claude + MCP stack — naming what should stay specialized just as plainly as what should consolidate. Assisted audit, always reviewed — never certifies compliance with any bar rule or security standard, and never accesses, changes, or cancels anything at any vendor.
